stories.headline: WSIB lowers the average premium rate for 2027
stories.body: Ontario announced October 22 that the average Workplace Safety and Insurance Board premium will fall to C$1.18 per C$100 of insurable payroll in 2027, from C$1.23 in 2026. The new rate takes effect January 1.
